highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 improves platform reliability, native hardening, and supported view integrations.
highlights_body: It rolls up the 3.119.3 preview work with Linux, Android, Tizen, and desktop fixes.

breaking.title: Blazor view surface changed
breaking.body: Review the API-diff report and update Blazor view code to use the current supported members before upgrading.

bullets.lead: Android GL views recover after tab switches
bullets.detail: MAUI applications no longer leave SKGLView blank after switching TabBar tabs.
Native packaging and runtime dependencies are corrected for Linux ARM64 applications.
The release adds 64-bit Tizen native support and Linux Bionic native assets.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic assets, Tizen support, and legacy target improvements
contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Windows and Linux native binary hardening
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed Android SKGLView rendering after tab switches

preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Preview 1 rolled up cross-platform reliability work from the 3.119 servicing line.
preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: The prior preview introduced Linux ARM64, AOT, and dependency servicing updates.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp carries the accompanying platform and native dependency updates.
